channel.title: Temporal incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Temporal's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Elevated Errors in us-west-2 Region [resolved]
item.description: As of 9/4 05:03 UTC, all affected MRN namespaces have been failed back to us-west-2. No further issues have been observed and this incident is resolved.

item.title: Low Rate of Namespace Create/Update Failures Across All Regions [resolved]
item.description: The rollback of the affected service has completed. Namespace configuration changes will resume as expected.

item.title: Elevated error rates in GCP us-central1 [resolved]
item.description: GCP is reporting that mitigations are in place, and that all services in this region are operational. MRN namespaces have been failed back to their primary regions.

item.title: Self-Signup Onboarding Access Restriction [resolved]
item.description:
Self-Signup onboarding was inadvertently restricted after a rollout, preventing users from completing Self-Signup onboarding.
The configuration change occurred on August 20 at 21:21 UTC, and the issue was noticed at approximately 12:40 UTC on August 21. The issue was mitigated at 13:01 UTC by correcting the onboarding configuration.
The onboarding configuration was corrected, and Self-Signup onboarding functionality has returned to normal.

item.title: Customers in (GCP) us-west1 may experience elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: We have continued to see normal activity in this region, with latencies holding at pre-incident levels. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Cloud Ops API — Elevated Error Rates and Latencies [resolved]
item.description:
We experienced a brief period of elevated error rates and latency on the Cloud Ops API, lasting approximately 5 minutes (from 11.41 UTC to 11.46 UTC).
The incident has been resolved, and the Cloud Ops API is operating normally. We are investigating the cause.
We apologize for the disruption.

item.title: Customers in AWS us-west-2 may experience elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: We have continued to see normal activity in this region, with latencies holding at pre-incident levels. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Some customers in AWS eu-west-1 may experience elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: No further errors and latencies have been observed and systems remain stable. The issue was capacity related and caused elevated database latencies. The service was scaled up and closely monitored until all latencies resolved.

item.title: Usage API and UI are experiencing an outage [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-west-2 may experience degraded visibility performance [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Visibility performance has been restored.

item.title: Some customers in GCP us-east4 may experience elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: API latencies have recovered and remained stable since the observed periods of elevated latency.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-west-2 may experience degraded visibility performance [resolved]
item.description: We're seeing recovery on our end and errors and latencies on Visibility APIs have dropped. We will continue to monitor this but the incident is mitigated and resolved.

item.title: Some customers in GCP us-east4 may experience elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers may have experienced lag in Temporal Cloud metrics (OpenMetrics - v1) from 12:45 to 13:25 UTC [resolved]
item.description: Some customers may have experienced lag in Temporal Cloud metrics (OpenMetrics - v1), starting from 12:45 UTC to 13:25 UTC. Metrics lag have since recovered back to nominal.

item.title: Some customers in AWS eu-west-1 may experience elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: We have continued to see normal activity in this region with latencies holding at pre-incident levels. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Customers in AWS eu-west-1 may experience elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: A spike in workload caused resource contention in the underlying infrastructure, resulting in elevated latency for critical APIs. We scaled up the underlying resources to handle the increased load, and latencies have returned to normal. We will continue to monitor the system, but the mitigation is complete and the incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers may experience a loss in metrics (v0 and v1) starting 19:00 UTC [resolved]
item.description: A configuration error caused a partial loss of metrics (v0 and v1) for some customers between 2026-07-16 19:00 UTC and 2026-07-17 02:12 UTC. We have updated the config and mitigated impact across impacted regions. All global metrics are now restored and the incident is resolved.

item.title: Customers in us-east-2 may experience some visibility related errors [resolved]
item.description: All MRN-enabled namespaces failed over by Temporal have been failed back. This incident has been fully mitigated and is now resolved.

item.title: Elevated latencies in us-east-1 [resolved]
item.description: Errors and latencies have recovered, incident has been resolved.

item.title: Broken Temporal skipping test server link [resolved]
item.description: A Java SDK release was incorrectly tagged, preventing the time-skipping test server from being published. After correcting the tag, rerunning the release workflow, and clearing the temporal.download cache, downloads were restored.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-west-2 may experience unjustified throttling errors [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-east-1 may experience elevated rate of API errors and elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: A set of fixes have been implemented and no further latency or failures have been observed in AWS us-east-1 since 17:00 UTC.

item.title: Customers in AWS us-east-1 may experience elevated rate of API errors and elevated latencies [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-east-1 may experience elevated rate of transient API errors [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Customers in GCP us-east4 may experience elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: The latencies were caused by issues with a downstream service which resolved after we scaled up. We've been monitoring for errors and latencies and have not seen any further issues. This issue is now considered resolved.

item.title: Some customers in GCP europe-west3 may experience elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers in AWS us-east-2 may have experienced elevated API latencies and errors [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some customers in GCP us-west1 may have experienced elevated API latencies [resolved]
item.description: Some customers in GCP us-west1 may have experienced elevated API latencies between 17:50 and 17:57 UTC.

item.title: Errors on GetSystemInfo and healthcheck endpoints for latest SDK versions [resolved]
item.description: The rollout is complete and resolves the compression issues. All listed affected versions should no longer experience any compression-related errors.

item.title: GCP customers in europe-west3 are experiencing elevated errors for Visibility API calls [resolved]
item.description: The region has recovered — visibility calls are succeeding without errors. The incident is resolved.
